es: Condensar un párrafo narrativo en un texto nominal de unas 60 palabras: convertir acciones en sustantivos, unir causa y efecto con caused, led to o due to y retomar con this delay.

teaching.en: The delay in construction caused anger among local families.
teaching.es: El retraso en la construcción causó enfado entre las familias del barrio.
teaching.explanationEs: delay y construction condensan dos acciones: alguien tardó y alguien construyó.
teaching.audioText: The delay in construction caused anger among local families.

teaching.en: A shortage of builders was the main reason for the delay.
teaching.es: La escasez de constructores fue la razón principal del retraso.
teaching.explanationEs: shortage of resume «no había suficientes constructores» en un grupo nominal.
segments: A shortage of builders was the
teaching.audioText: A shortage of builders was the main reason for the delay.

teaching.en: The council's investment in the library brought a rise in visitors.
teaching.es: La inversión del ayuntamiento en la biblioteca trajo un aumento de visitantes.
teaching.explanationEs: investment + in; brought (un verbo de causa) une dos sustantivos.
segments: The council's investment in the library
teaching.audioText: The council's investment in the library brought a rise in visitors.

teaching.en: The main consequence of the delay was a rise in costs.
teaching.es: La consecuencia principal del retraso fue un aumento de los costos.
teaching.explanationEs: consequence of + sustantivo retoma la idea anterior sin repetirla.
segments: The main consequence of the delay
teaching.audioText: The main consequence of the delay was a rise in costs.

teaching.en: The outcome was positive, although the delay left a bad memory.
teaching.es: El resultado final fue positivo, aunque el retraso dejó mal recuerdo.
teaching.explanationEs: outcome resume cómo terminó la historia.
segments: The outcome was positive, although the
teaching.audioText: The outcome was positive, although the delay left a bad memory.

teaching.en: We can condense the story: the late construction, due to a shortage of builders, angered local families.
teaching.es: Podemos condensar la historia: la construcción tardía, debido a la escasez de constructores, enfadó a las familias del barrio.
teaching.explanationEs: Condensar es juntar varias frases en una con grupos nominales y due to.

prompt.es: Condensa el párrafo de la biblioteca en unas 60 palabras con cuatro nominalizaciones.

answer.text: The late construction of the new library, due to a shortage of workers, caused a two-year delay and anger among local families. The rise in costs, which resulted from expensive materials and extra months of pay, increased the council's investment. However, the outcome has been positive: the opening in September has led to a large increase in visitors and in children's reading.
accepted: The late construction of the new library, due to a shortage of workers, caused a two-year delay and anger among local families. The rise in costs, which resulted from expensive materials and extra months of pay, increased the council's investment. However, the outcome has been positive: the opening in September has led to a large increase in visitors and in children's reading.

A shortage of workers in the region caused a delay of two years in the construction of the library, and families expressed anger in many complaints. The rise in the cost of materials and pay increased the council's investment, but the outcome is good: weekly visits have risen above one thousand and children read more.

feedback.es: Un buen texto condensado usa delay, shortage of, un verbo de causa o due to, y una nominalización de costos y del resultado final, en unas 60 palabras.

origin.text: Last year the council decided to build a new library in our neighbourhood. The builders were late because there were not enough workers in the region. As a result, the library opened two years late. The families were angry and many of them wrote complaints. Meanwhile the costs rose, because the materials became more expensive and the council had to pay the workers for extra months. Finally the library opened in September. The council invested a lot of money, and the result was good: every week more than a thousand visitors arrive, and the children read much more than before.

The rise in prices led to a fall in purchases.

feedback.es: Rise y purchases sustituyen a los verbos y led to une causa y efecto; las otras versiones copian la estructura española.

origin.text: Because prices rose, people bought less.
